items.rationale: Sentence handed down in the first federal music streaming-fraud case: 18 months in prison and $8.09M forfeiture for using bots to stream AI-generated songs. It sets a concrete penalty benchmark for AI-slop stream farming.
items.excerpt: Michael Smith was sentenced to 18 months and ordered to forfeit $8.09M for using bot accounts to generate billions of fake streams of AI-generated songs on Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon and YouTube Music - the first federal music streaming-fraud case.

items.rationale: Denmark has tabled revised legislation giving performers, and people generally, the right to block unapproved AI replicas of their voice or likeness, targeted for early 2027. It is a concrete new legal tool against vocal deepfakes.
items.excerpt: Danish culture minister Zenia Stampe presented revised proposals to parliament for new rights letting performers, and people generally, block unapproved AI digital replicas of their voice or likeness, with the law expected to take effect in early 2027.

items.rationale: Google Flow Music now exports prompt-built instruments and effects as VST3/AU plugins that run in any DAW. Producers can build custom tools in plain language without writing code.
items.excerpt: Google Flow Music now lets producers export custom 'Spaces' - instruments and effects built from natural-language prompts - as VST3/AU plugins that run inside their DAWs, no coding required.

items.rationale: Sonilo launches a multimodal system that reads a video's pacing, emotion and story to generate time-aligned music, a new route for soundtrack and sync work. Lead with Sonilo; Base for Music was already covered on 10-09.
items.excerpt: Music Ally's weekly AI round-up: Sonilo launches a multimodal AI system that reads a video's pacing, emotion and storyline to generate time-aligned music, plus AI updates from Laylo and others.

items.rationale: New research shows input-based attribution can give verifiable evidence of which source recordings shaped an AI-generated track. That is the technical basis that licensing and royalty schemes for AI music need.
items.excerpt: How can we verify whose music contributed to an AI-generated output? The paper shows input-based attribution can give verifiable evidence of which audio sources were used in a generation and whether they shaped the output.
